description: This file defines controller functions for handling node-related API endpoints in an Express.js application, including fetching nodes, getting node icons, and executing custom functions.

methods.name: getAllNodes
methods.description: Handles request to retrieve all nodes.

methods.name: getNodeByName
methods.description: Handles request to retrieve a node by its name.

methods.name: getNodesByCategory
methods.description: Handles request to retrieve nodes by category name.

methods.name: getSingleNodeIcon
methods.description: Handles request to retrieve a node's icon file.

methods.name: getSingleNodeAsyncOptions
methods.description: Handles request to retrieve async options for a specific node.

methods.name: executeCustomFunction
methods.description: Handles request to execute a custom function on a node.
